entries.title: Did ChatGPT just create a real life Jarvis?? #chatgpt #ai #codex #openai #aitips
entries.summary: A short teasing that ChatGPT/Codex might power a real-life 'Jarvis'-style assistant, but the clip is just a title card with hashtags and shows no actual demo or feature detail.

entries.title: OpenAI's AI Assistant: Email Reading Powerhouse? #shorts
entries.summary: OpenAI is reportedly developing an AI assistant capable of reading through a user's sent emails, raising privacy questions about how much personal data the tool would access. The short poses the idea as a discussion prompt rather than demonstrating a shipped feature.

entries.title: AI Creator Academy helps you build and monetize AI characters with free training. #AI #Creator
entries.summary: Promotional short for an unnamed platform and its 'AI Creator Academy' free training program, which pitches monetizing AI characters through subscriptions, paid content, and fan messaging. The description reads as generic marketing copy without naming the actual product.

entries.title: Claude Limit Hit? Auto-Switch to Free Models Instantly
entries.summary: A short promotes a local-router setup that plugs Claude Code into OpenRouter's free-model catalog and auto-switches when the current model hits its rate limit, letting a coding session continue without a paid Claude plan upgrade. The specific router tool isn't named in the description; the linked setup doc could not be fetched (permission-gated).

entries.title: The FREE GitHub skill that deletes every AI tell.
entries.summary: The video points to Humanizer, an open-source (MIT) agent skill on GitHub with 31.6k stars that rewrites AI-drafted text to strip ~33 known LLM writing tells derived from Wikipedia's AI-article detection work, while preserving facts. It installs via the Skills CLI or as a Claude Code plugin.

entries.title: How to Automate an Accounting Firm
entries.summary: Short titled 'How to Automate an Accounting Firm' with no description or transcript beyond the title, so no concrete automation method or tool is shown.

entries.title: Opus 5 Just Killed Prompt Injection: 0% Attack Success
entries.summary: The video reports that Anthropic's Opus 5 achieved a 0% attack success rate across 129 browser-agent prompt-injection scenarios when its 'Auto Mode' two-layer defense (pre-scanning data, then gating risky actions) is on; with the defense off, attack success was 3.7% on Opus 5 and 2.8% on Fable 5. OpenAI is cited as saying prompt injection may never be fully solvable.

entries.title: Claude fable 5 is INSANE #claude #seo #entrepreneur #website #landingsitepartner
entries.summary: A short from the Landingsite channel calling 'Claude Fable 5' insane for website/SEO/landing-page work, but the clip is just the title card with hashtags and shows no actual demo.

entries.title: Oracle Cuts 21,000 Jobs and Admits AI Is the Reason
entries.summary: Oracle disclosed in an official filing that it cut 21,000 jobs (headcount down 13%, from about 162k to 141k) over one fiscal year, and attributed part of the cuts to AI replacing roles alongside cost pressure from a $300B compute deal with OpenAI. The video frames this within a wider ~$600B big-tech AI infrastructure spending trend this year.

ChatGPT Health Just Launched for Every US Adult: What It Does
entries.summary: OpenAI launched ChatGPT Health to every US adult across all plan tiers, integrating with Apple Health, Peloton, MyFitnessPal, and medical records via b.well so it can read lab results, explain diagnoses, and prepare questions ahead of a doctor's visit.

entries.title: Use GPT 5.6 Inside Claude Code
entries.summary: The video demonstrates splitting a coding job between an expensive 'thinking' model (Claude) and a cheaper 'typing' model (GPT 5.6), using OpenAI's Codex Plugin for Claude Code (installed via the Claude Code marketplace) to run GPT as the execution layer for roughly half the token cost of one frontier model doing everything.

entries.title: Anthropic solves Jacobian Conjecture using Fable 5 #anthropic #jacobianconjecture #mathematics
entries.summary: The video claims Anthropic used Claude 'Fable 5' to find a concrete counterexample disproving the 87-year-old Jacobian Conjecture, calling it independently checkable on Wolfram Alpha and verified by mathematicians. This is an extraordinary, third-party-reported claim from a small channel with no primary source cited, so it should be treated as unverified until an official Anthropic or peer-reviewed source confirms it.

entries.title: I partnered with @OpenAI to show how I use Codex in the new ChatGPT desktop app 👀 #ChatGPT_Partner
entries.summary: In an OpenAI-sponsored clip, a developer shows using Codex inside the new ChatGPT desktop app to consolidate feedback from a feedback board, app store reviews, and customer emails in one prompt, rank it by ROI, then start a new thread to build the top feature.

entries.title: Canva Code 2 combines AI website generation with Canva's visual editor
entries.summary: Canva Code 2 pairs AI website generation with Canva's visual editor, letting users start from a prompt and then manually edit text, images, fonts, colors, and individual elements — including importing and continuing sites originally built with other AI website builders.
